CF.description: Source flags coordinate uncertainty, likely coordinate problems, or georeferenced coordinates.

CI.description: Coordinates were assigned from lookup tables or interpolated along transects.

CS.description: Site or event coordinate is repeated for observations that are more spatially granular than the coordinate.

DA.description: Date was assigned from a reported year, a campaign midpoint, or a representative thaw-season convention.

DO.description: Known potential overlap with another source remains, or source-specific deduplication affected interpretation.

DR.description: Depth is measured from a source reference surface that differs from the usual ground or moss surface and was not converted.

DS.description: Source flags the observation date as approximate, range-based, or otherwise imprecise.

FE.description: Value or coordinate was extracted, georeferenced, or digitized from a figure.

GI.description: Depth was inferred from GPR, ERT, or other geophysical interpretation rather than direct probing or coring.

LB.description: Permafrost was not reached within the reported probe profile or observation limit.

ME.description: Source or CUSP processor uses modeled, estimated, extrapolated, or reconstructed depth.

MU.description: Observation method is unknown or mapped approximately into the CUSP method vocabulary.

OA.description: Observation limit was assigned from protocol, source interpretation, or processor convention rather than a row-specific measured limit.

PA.description: Permafrost presence state was assigned from context, a threshold, aggregation, or proxy coding rather than an explicit row-level detection or state.

PB.description: Permafrost absence is interpreted to the bottom of an observed soil or profile record.

RC.description: Units, sentinels, coordinate signs, or source codes were recoded to make the row usable.

RO.description: Field notes indicate rock, gravel, obstruction, bottoming out, road, water, or similar ambiguity.

SS.description: Canonical observation value is a mean annual site summary or other source or processor summary statistic.

TI.description: Permafrost state or depth was inferred from temperature profile logic.

UB.description: Permafrost was confirmed but exact thaw or permafrost depth is only bounded.

VA.description: Reported depth was bounded, approximate, or ranged, and CUSP retained one representative numeric value.

VI.description: Permafrost presence or absence was assigned from visual field or mapped-feature interpretation rather than a subsurface instrument measurement; coordinates may be representative samples from mapped areas.
